title: report 01 bridge
summary: Voice bridge Relay-7 reported dead air from ~0355Z. NOC observed crash-loop on host vb-07. Core routers remained green.

title: report 02 node b
summary: Power flicker at Node B coincident with bridge outage window. No cable damage found on walkdown. Weather cell overhead.

title: report 03 media
summary: Single outlet asked whether outage was "cyber attack." No technical indicators in ops feeds.

title: report 04 restore
summary: Relay-7 restored. Root cause: process crash on vb-07. Postmortem scheduled 1400Z.

title: report 05 convoy
summary: Convoy reported clear of Checkpoint 2 at 0340Z. Checkpoint traffic normal by 0400Z.

title: report 06 export eu
summary: EU queue depth elevated; US normal. Flag eu-export-v2 suspected. Finance blocked on month-close CSV for EU tenants.
